name: Alsópáhok (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Alsópáhok: a blue and red shield with a monogram and a wing, with a helm, a crest and red, blue and grey mantling, above a yellow scroll inscribed ALSÓPÁHOK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Alsópáhok arms with helm, crest, mantling and scroll
